python -c "
from wordfreq import tokenize, top_words, main
assert tokenize('Hello, world! Hello.') == ['hello', 'world', 'hello']
assert tokenize(\"'''\") == []
assert tokenize(\"don't stop rock'n'roll\") == [\"don't\", 'stop', \"rock'n'roll\"]
assert tokenize(\"'quoted'\") == ['quoted']
assert tokenize('a-b') == ['a', 'b']
assert tokenize('x1 2y') == ['x1', '2y']
assert top_words('b b a a c', 2) == [('a', 2), ('b', 2)]
assert top_words('z z z y', 10) == [('z', 3), ('y', 1)]
assert top_words('', 5) == []
try:
    top_words('x', 0)
    raise SystemExit('expected ValueError')
except ValueError:
    pass
print('api ok')
"
python -c "
import subprocess, sys
def run(args, stdin):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'wordfreq.py', *args], input=stdin, capture_output=True, text=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr
code, out, err = run(['-n', '2'], 'b b a a c')
assert code == 0 and out == 'a\t2\nb\t2\n' and err == '', (code, out, err)
code, out, err = run([], '')
assert code == 0 and out == '' and err == '', (code, out, err)
code, out, err = run(['-n', '0'], 'x')
assert code == 2 and out == '' and err != '', (code, out, err)
code, out, err = run(['-n', 'abc'], 'x')
assert code == 2 and out == '' and err != '', (code, out, err)
code, out, err = run(['--top', '2'], 'b b a a c')
assert code == 0 and out == 'a\t2\nb\t2\n', (code, out, err)
print('cli ok')
"
